script.title: THE SHIRT STAIN
script.scene_zh: 乾洗店 · 指出襯衫污漬
script.story_hook: A man brings a wine-stained shirt to the dry cleaner.
script.intro_zh: 一位先生把沾了紅酒的襯衫送到乾洗店。
script.welcome_en: Hello there, glad you dropped by! Today we're at the dry cleaner's.
script.welcome_zh: 大家好，很高興你來！今天我們來到乾洗店。
script.outro: Stain handled, shirt saved, picked up at four. Nice work today.
script.outro_zh: 污漬搞定、襯衫得救、四點取件。今天表現不錯。
script.practice_intro_en: Repeat each line after me, one by one.
script.practice_intro_zh: 跟我一句一句重複這些句子。
script.char_a_description: a tired office man in his fifties with salt-and-pepper side-parted hair and thin reading glasses, wearing a plain gray sweater over an oxford collar, holding up a white shirt by its shoulders
script.char_b_description: a sharp-eyed attendant in her thirties with dark hair in a sleek low bun, wearing a black apron over a striped long-sleeve shirt, tilting the garment to inspect a care tag

Spilled red wine on your favorite shirt? This dry cleaner conversation shows exactly what to say. A customer points out the stain, confirms the fabric, asks about same-day service and the rush fee, and leaves with a receipt and a four o'clock pickup time. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a full listen-and-repeat section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】👔乾洗店英文｜指出污漬・確認布料・急件取件｜聽完就會送洗問價｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
襯衫滴到紅酒，用英文怎麼跟乾洗店交代？
能不能當天取、會不會收急件費？

這一集帶大家走進街角的乾洗店，跟著一位先生從指出污漬、聽懂別用熱水的提醒、確認純棉布料，到付急件費、當天四點取件，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🍷 交代污漬：例如「Red wine, last night. A big splash.」、「Hot water sets stains like that.」。
🏷️ 確認布料：例如「What fabric is it?」、「The tag says pure cotton, I think.」。
⏱️ 急件與取件：例如「Do you offer anything same-day?」、「just show it at pickup.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次衣服髒了，走進乾洗店慢慢說！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a red wine mark on a white shirt
script.title_quote: Hot water sets stains like that

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, can you look at this shirt?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ kæn ju lʊk æt ðɪs ʃɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，能請你看看這件襯衫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Red wine, last night. A big splash.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd waɪn læst naɪt ə bɪɡ splæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 昨晚的紅酒，潑了一大片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, did you try washing it already?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ dɪd ju traɪ ˈwɑʃɪŋ ɪt ɔlˈrɛdi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope, I brought it straight here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call. Hot water sets stains like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl hɑt ˈwɔtər sɛts steɪnz laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 判斷對了，這種污漬碰到熱水會定型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, will it come out completely?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most likely, yes. What fabric is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈlaɪkli jɛs wʌt ˈfæbrɪk ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 機會很大。這是什麼布料？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tag says pure cotton, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡæ sɛz pyʊr ˈkɑtən aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 標籤上寫的應該是純棉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we're in good shape, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 那情況樂觀，老實說沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們有當天取件的服務嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, there's a rush fee of four dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðɛrz ə rʌʃ fi əv fɔr ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 有的，不過急件要收四美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fine. I need it for Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn aɪ nid ɪt fɔr ˈfraɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，我星期五要用這件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll have it by four today, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /jul hæv ɪt baɪ fɔr təˈdeɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那今天四點前你就會拿到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing. Should I get a receipt now?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪzɪŋ ʃʊd aɪ ɡɛt ə rɪˈsit naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我現在先拿收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, here you go, just show it at pickup.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɪr ju ɡoʊ dʒʌst ʃoʊ ɪt æt ˈpɪkˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 對，給你，取件時出示就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. You've saved my week, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt jʊz seɪvd maɪ wiːk ˈsɪrəsli/
dialogue.zh: 知道了。你真的救了我這一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, happy to help. Back at four!
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈhæpi tə hɛlp bæk æt fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 哈，很高興能幫忙。四點再來取！
